verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no eval runs, datasets, or scored experiment comparisons. The LLM Calls view lets you compare models, prompts, cost, and performance across production model requests, but that is a related observability feature, not side-by-side comparison of eval runs for catching regressions. That adjacent capability earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions
